description: Expander for INTERMIX, placed immediately to the right of it, turning the fades of one selected input column into envelopes.

outputs.text: Carries a 0-10V envelope following the fade of the selected input column into that output, or a plain gate where that input is not set to linear fade.

notes: the outputs carry nothing until an input column is chosen on the display's menu.
menu: Input — on the display's own right-click menu, choosing which input column of INTERMIX the envelopes follow.
